    text_lower = text.lower()
    return any(f' {term} ' in f' {text_lower} ' or 
               f' {term}.' in f' {text_lower} ' or
               f' {term},' in f' {text_lower} ' or
               text_lower.startswith(f'{term} ') or
               text_lower.endswith(f' {term}')

def has_female_gendered(text):
